title: No host-recognized way to run the UI Vitest suite with cwd=ui through the launcher: the bash -c wrapper stays 'pending/unclassified' and earns no verification credit
outcome: There is one documented launcher invocation for the full UI Vitest suite that runs with cwd = ui/ (which test-categories.test.ts requires) AND that the host recognizes, so a passing committed-input run produces a settled verification record. Agents no longer have to choose between a correct run that earns no credit and a credited run that fails on the cwd.
acceptance: No host-recognized way to run the UI Vitest suite with cwd=ui through the launcher: the bash -c wrapper stays 'pending/unclassified' and earns no verification credit is done
